entries.5be1845349127d41: Under its long-term vision 'Vision2030' toward 2030, it aims to become 'a leading water-related company that enhances the value of the KVK brand and is needed by people around the world.' Its 3-year medium-term management plan, with the fiscal year ending March 2027 as its first year, sets a policy of working on 'evolution of sales capability and product competitiveness,' 'evolution of production capacity,' and 'strengthening of the management foundation from a sustainability perspective.'
entries.5df9d95ee3455317: The Japan segment accounts for the majority of revenue, while revenue from external customers in the China segment is limited to ¥486 million. Amid a declining trend in new housing starts, the company is expanding the Multi-Reform Faucet Series to meet renovation demand.
